name: ai-sdlc
description: The six-stage AI-native software development lifecycle from Anthropic's playbook, as an executable CodeBuddy plugin. Each stage produces one version-controlled Markdown artifact and stops at a human gate: Plan writes intent.md, Design turns an accepted intent into spec.md, Build turns an accepted spec into plan.md then implements it, Test proves the change and regression-tests the agent config itself, Deploy runs the REVIEW.md passes on the PR and stops for human approval, Maintain watches bands.yaml control bands and files the next intent.md when a band breaks. Ships eight skills, two read-only subagents, artifact-gate and prod-guard hooks, and templates. Every hook is inert unless the repository contains a .sdlc/ directory.
